task_objective: Fix hidden-column selection copy/export resolution, add selection statistics above the results grid, and add a non-modal cell value inspector.
design_decisions: selection_for_export now creates a visual-position map for every logical column, including hidden ones, while its selected-cell list still excludes hidden columns. The shared TSV and selection-export consumers can therefore resolve the same visual index correctly without changes.

Selection statistics use the source Polars frame and the corrected visual-to-model map. They aggregate selected values in Polars rather than reading display-role QModelIndex values, preserving typed numeric aggregation and excluding nulls from numeric calculations.

Mixed-dtype selections keep each gathered column typed. Values are grouped by dtype before distinct counts are combined, so Polars never needs to find a supertype for numeric values and JSON List or Struct values.
The summary label lives directly below the persistent result summary rather than in the status bar, so it remains visible while the selection remains active.

The inspector renders raw UserRole values with pretty JSON for dict/list structures or valid JSON text. It intentionally does not use TSV escaping, caps only displayed text, and copies the untruncated rendered value.
Inspector windows use the ValueCountsWindow retention pattern: MainWindow retains each non-modal window, removes it after destruction, and closes all remaining inspectors during shutdown.

deferred_and_unverified: No manual GUI verification was performed. Visual placement of the selection label, inspector readability at real window sizes, and native-dialog behavior remain unverified.
Performance was not measured. SelectionChanged frequency on 100,000-row selections and multi-megabyte inspector values remain unbenchmarked assumptions behind the typed aggregation and display cap.
Spark was not exercised. The suite ran with -m 'not spark'; the conclusion that these UI changes are engine-independent is reasoning rather than measurement.
No audit was made for callers other than serialize_to_tsv and selected_frame that might resolve columns by visual index.
